about: Which property in other battery and product-passport models corresponds to each EC DPP 1.0.0 battery field. Every mapping was checked against the source files listed; match is exact, close, broader, narrower or partial, with a note on differences.

conventions.path: catenax: JSON payload path from the aspect root; batterypass: '<AspectFile>:<payload path>'; untp: JSON path in the DigitalProductPassport credential. [] = list item; [key=value] = pick the list entry with that value.
conventions.ref: Identifier of the leaf (or container) property: SAMM URN for catenax/batterypass, JSON-LD term IRI from untp-context.jsonld for untp.

catenax.note: Catena-X requires a UUID v4 (optionally urn:uuid:); EC allows any string.

batterypass.note: Constrained to the pattern ^urn:[a-z0-9]+:[a-z0-9]+$; EC allows any string.

untp.note: Identifier (URI) of the passport credential itself; EC passport id is a plain string.

catenax.note: Described as the unique identifier linked from the QR code (Art. 77(3)); same idea, free string.

batterypass.note: Same meaning (Art. 3(66)); Battery Pass also says it identifies the passport.

untp.note: Must be a URI (identifier scheme + identifier, or a DID); EC allows any string. Scheme given separately in credentialSubject.idScheme.
Same three levels (model, batch, item) but coded as plain strings; EC uses IRIs from its granularity-level code list.

catenax.note: Values draft/approved/invalid/expired, optional; EC has only valid/invalid (instance-status code list).

untp.note: UNTP uses a W3C Bitstring Status List entry (revocation/suspension) rather than a status value in the passport. Term not defined in the UNTP context file; it comes from the W3C credentials context.

catenax.note: Date only (yyyy-mm-dd) and optional; EC requires xsd:dateTime.

untp.note: Start of validity of this credential version; an updated passport is a newly issued credential, so this approximates last update but is not defined as such.

catenax.note: An identifier (BPNL in Catena-X) of the passport owner, not a name.

batterypass.note: Battery Pass 'operator information' (DIN DKE SPEC 99100 6.1.2.3); unclear whether it is the party responsible for the passport (Art. 77(4)).

untp.note: Name of the organisation issuing the passport credential; issuer is not explicitly defined as the responsible economic operator.

catenax.note: BPNL company number only; no name, trade name or trademark fields.

batterypass.note: Contact block with name, postal address, identifier, optional email and web.

untp.note: Party with role 'manufacturer'; has legal name and identifiers, no trade name or trademark fields.

batterypass.note: Free text 'contactName'; not explicitly the legal or registered name.

untp.note: 'Legal registered name of this party'.

batterypass.note: Structured as addressCountry, postalCode, streetAddress only (no town/city field); EC is a single string.

untp.note: Structured address (street, postal code, locality, region, country); EC is a single string.

batterypass.note: Email and web address sit inside the general manufacturer contact block.
Optional URI in both.

untp.note: Optional URI.

batterypass.note: Plain text with an email pattern; EC types it as xsd:anyURI.

catenax.note: Six values (SLI, LMT, EV, industrial, portable, incorporated) as strings; EC has three IRI codes (EVB, LMT, industrial >2 kWh).

batterypass.note: Values lmt, ev, industrial, stationary (strings); EC has no separate 'stationary' and uses IRI codes.

catenax.note: Container of serial, batch, part type, codes; also data-carrier and classification.

untp.note: modelNumber, batchNumber and itemNumber sit directly on the product.

catenax.note: Manufacturer part number used as model id; defined in io.catenax.part_type_information:1.0.0 (not downloaded; path from generated schema).

untp.note: Optional string in both.

catenax.note: Key/value list; batch number is the entry with key 'batchId'. Defined in io.catenax.batch:3.0.0 (path from generated schema).

untp.note: Optional string in both.

catenax.note: Key/value list; serial is the entry with key 'partInstanceId'. Defined in io.catenax.serial_part:3.0.0 (path from generated schema).

untp.note: 'Specific serialised item' number; same intent, different name.

catenax.note: Generic key/value codes (e.g. GTIN); no dedicated product number.
Generic key/value codes can carry other identifiers.
Facility given only as a BPNA site number; no town, region or country fields.

batterypass.note: Postal address (country, postal code, street); no town or region field.

untp.note: Reference to a facility (id, name); its address lives in a separate facility record.

batterypass.note: Free text (example 'DE'); EC requires a 3-letter upper-case code (^[A-Z]{3}$).

untp.note: ISO 3166 code from UN/CEFACT CountryId list (address docs say two-letter); EC requires 3 letters.

catenax.note: Full date yyyy-mm-dd and optional; EC requires month and year (xsd:gYearMonth).

batterypass.note: xsd:dateTimeStamp (full timestamp); EC is month and year.

untp.note: Full date, optional; EC is month and year, required.

catenax.note: value + unit, unit from a list (gram, kilogram, tonne, pound ...); EC allows only kg or g.

batterypass.note: Fixed unit kilogram; EC allows kg or g.

untp.note: value + UN/ECE Rec 20 unit code (e.g. KGM); EC uses its own unit IRIs.

catenax.note: Catena-X has one rated capacity (Ah) covering both the label capacity and Annex IV rated capacity; EC keeps two fields and allows mAh.

batterypass.note: Only 'rated capacity' (Ah) exists; EC keeps label capacity separate.

catenax.note: Free text (e.g. 'NCM'); EC requires a code from its battery-chemistry list.

batterypass.note: Free text shortName + clearName; EC uses a code list.

catenax.note: Structured list (id, concentration, unit, location, impact docs) instead of free text.

batterypass.note: Structured list (hazard class, name, concentration %, CAS, location, impact); EC is free text.

untp.note: Only a yes/no flag per material, plus a safety-information link.

catenax.note: List of agents with fire class; plain text, not language-tagged.

batterypass.note: List of plain strings; not language-tagged.

catenax.note: Yes/no flag per listed material; EC requires codes from the EU critical raw material list.

batterypass.note: Yes/no flag per material (with name and CAS number); EC uses a code list.

catenax.note: Given per material, not for the whole battery.

batterypass.note: Single percentage for the battery.

catenax.note: Volts; one optional test temperature shared by all three voltages, where EC allows a temperature range per value.

batterypass.note: Volts; no temperature range.

catenax.note: Volts; one optional test temperature shared by all three voltages, where EC allows a temperature range per value.

batterypass.note: Volts; no temperature range.

catenax.note: Volts; one optional test temperature shared by all three voltages, where EC allows a temperature range per value.

batterypass.note: Volts; no temperature range.

catenax.note: Watts; Catena-X adds values at 20% and 80% state of charge.

batterypass.note: List of (state of charge %, power capability) pairs; the power value is declared in percent, not watts.
Single value in kilowatts; EC uses watts and allows several values with temperature ranges.

catenax.note: Integer within the cycle-life test block (with temperature, depth of discharge, C-rates).

batterypass.note: Integer number of cycles.

catenax.note: List of documents (header, content, type), not free text.

batterypass.note: A link (URI), not free text.

catenax.note: Percent.

batterypass.note: Percent, but defined as a share of certified energy (SOCE) rather than of capacity.

catenax.note: lower/upper in °C; the lower/upper descriptions speak of operating temperature although the parent cites the not-in-use requirement (Annex XIII 1(l)).

batterypass.note: Modelled as a single °C value constrained to -20..60, not a min/max pair.

catenax.note: Document list whose description cites the not-in-use reference test, but also covers all compliance test reports.
lifeValue + lifeUnit (day, month, year, cycle, operating hour); EC is integer months.

batterypass.note: Unit month, but datatype xsd:gMonth (a calendar month, not a count); property name is spelt 'warrenty'.

catenax.note: Percent.

batterypass.note: Percent; not explicitly labelled 'initial', but sits among pre-use properties.

catenax.note: Percent.

batterypass.note: Percent; placed in the in-use condition block.

catenax.note: Ohm.

batterypass.note: List of (ohm value, component pack/module/cell); select component 'cell'.

catenax.note: Ohm.

batterypass.note: List of (ohm value, component); select component 'pack'.

catenax.note: Dimensionless double; EC states it as a number.

batterypass.note: One C-rate value; no separate charge and discharge values.

catenax.note: Dimensionless double; EC gives unit 'reciprocal hour'.

batterypass.note: One C-rate value; no separate charge and discharge values.
A label entry with a symbol link and meaning text, not a yes/no value.

untp.note: Embedded label images (base64); not a yes/no value.

batterypass.note: Label entry with symbol link; no Cd/Pb/none code.

untp.note: Embedded label images; no Cd/Pb/none code.

catenax.note: List of documents (header, content, contentType); Catena-X also has an optional declarationOfConformityId.

batterypass.note: A single link (URI); EC resource also carries title, media type and language.

untp.note: Generic document link (URL, name, media type, link type); no dedicated declaration-of-conformity property in v0.7.0.

catenax.note: Holds separateCollection and wastePrevention document lists (plus optional taxonomy/sustainability reports).

batterypass.note: Three links: wastePrevention, separateCollection, informationOnCollection.

catenax.note: Document list instead of language-tagged text.
